thread:
oliver: Quick thread  I pushed a small lexicon sweep: merged 'model-serving' and 'inference runtime' glossary entries, normalized tags in the phrasebank, and adjusted a couple SDK examples to match param naming. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999
maya: thanks. did you leave redirects for old anchors?
oliver: yes — added redirect entries and kept human-readable aliases in parens. also added HTML anchors where anchors were referenced from other pages.
henry: SDK impact? which snippets changed?
oliver: JS quickstart: renamed `apiKey` -> `api_key` in examples; Python sample swapped the deprecated alias to the explicit model id but left an inline deprecation note.
maya: please keep the public quickstart copy-stable. users copy-paste that a lot.
oliver: agreed. I left the visible alias and added a one-line comment above the snippet showing the new recommended value.
viv: editorial note: i scanned tone for the deprecation wording. kept it short: "Deprecated: `gpt-3`. Use `rw/<model-id>`." flagged contraction guidance (security warnings) for follow-up.
docs-bot: preview build available: https://deployments.preview/redwood/docs/4999 :white_check_mark:
henry: i'll run linkcheck and snapshot regen after merge. nothing blocking from my side.
maya: timeline ok to merge today?
oliver: aiming for 5pm PT. ping me for any last-minute nits.
viv: i'll do a quick editorial pass post-merge and update a tiny note about contractions in the style guide.
oliver: thanks all :rocket:
